IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[DIM_MEDICAMENTO]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = '[dbo]')
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[DIM_MEDICAMENTO]
	(
	 [ID_DIM_MEDICAMENTO] int,
	 [ID_MEDICAMENTO] bigint,
	 [NOMBRE_MEDICAMENTO] nvarchar(4000),
	 [PRESENTACION] nvarchar(4000),
	 [CONCENTRACION] nvarchar(4000),
	 [CATEGORIA] nvarchar(4000)
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

--Uncomment the 4 lines below to create a stored procedure for data pipeline orchestration​

--AS
--BEGIN
COPY INTO [dbo].[DIM_MEDICAMENTO]
(ID_DIM_MEDICAMENTO 1, ID_MEDICAMENTO 2, NOMBRE_MEDICAMENTO 3, PRESENTACION 4, CONCENTRACION 5, CATEGORIA 6)
FROM 'https://azpaciencareetl.dfs.core.windows.net/datosprocesados/dw/DIM_MEDICAMENTO.parquet'
WITH
(
	FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET'
	,MAXERRORS = 0
)
--END
GO

SELECT TOP 100 * FROM [dbo].[DIM_MEDICAMENTO]
GO
